Synthetic payment UI test fixtures only. These are not receipts and do not represent real transactions. They have no real transaction identifiers, account details, sender details, or provider branding. Every image is visibly marked SAMPLE / NOT A REAL PAYMENT. Do not submit them as proof of payment.

Amounts are based on the checked-in system seed data: Package A day-tour price PHP 7,000.00; the 15% downpayment is PHP 1,050.00. Seed values may differ from the live site configuration.
